comment: The ordering followed training progress, with architecture resolving the middle: high-rate RMSprop on the one-layer GRU beat its low-rate AdamW counterpart; that simpler AdamW GRU beat the slower two-layer RMSprop GRU. Both low-rate SGD transformers remained undertrained, with momentum helping B over plain-SGD A. K1001, K1019, and K1012 supported these progress comparisons. K1071 supplied caution against blindly maximizing learning rate, but its high-rate penalties against substantially trained rivals did not justify rejecting D here. No new general rule was established.
